hypothesis: a shared 8-dimensional token embedding plus a 32-unit MLP can improve frozen Top-5 homograph ranking

architecture.inputs: candidate, previous Top-1, next Top-1, frozen emission, token roles, formula position
architecture.candidate_policy: same-family Top-5 reorder only; no token invention or grouping mutation

training.epoch_selection: outer-train-only formula-disjoint validation; final refit on all outer training formulas

direct.scope: project-owned three-writer LOO; no O, o, or vertical-bar truth

crohme.scope: CC BY-NC research-only five-fold formula-disjoint; never a product model

limitations: The evaluation datasets were already inspected in prior reranker development and are not untouched final acceptance sets.
Only truth-group character ranking is tested; grouping, spatial relations, and formula decoding remain outside this experiment.
A neural gain on CROHME cannot authorize commercial training or deployment.
